source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相欲翻，静压欲破
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC36 after EP02 SC35 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where conclusion and restraint are nearly beyond recovery into the next threshold: Keshadu's certainty is close to becoming overt fact, Shisilang's fury is near visible rupture, Tuobaye is almost entirely spent, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is one step from breaking open.
title: 真相欲翻，静压欲破

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC35 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC35 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相欲定，十四郎怒线欲裂，拓拔野已近见底，白衣女子的静压已到欲翻边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推到真正无法挽回的前夜。科沙度的判断几乎就是事实，十四郎的怒线也已经靠近断裂，拓拔野只剩最后的惯性支撑。白衣女子的克制则来到只差一线就要翻开的边界。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从欲翻推进到真正即将翻开的门前，为明确的出手或揭露做最后蓄压。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled until the true source beat finally tips over; avoid premature decorative spectacle.
Keshadu should feel nearly certain enough to make concealment meaningless.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to visible rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: near-fixed truth, rupture-edge fury, bottomed-out endurance, and turning restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
